GROUP_FIELD_DEFINITIONS.GROUPS_SERVED: normative (AR2-08; AR4-17): GROUPS_SERVED(s) = the ordered union of AFFECTED_GROUPS(c) of the BA-02a registry for every control c of CONTROLS_EXERCISED(s), taken in the order of CONTROLS_EXERCISED, followed by the groups of EVIDENCE_GROUPS_DECLARED(s) not already present; nothing else. A control that the run only records (RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED) or does not reach is not in CONTROLS_EXERCISED
GROUP_FIELD_DEFINITIONS.CONTRACT_ASSIGNED_GROUPS: normative (AR3-06 as extended by AR4-03; AR4-17): a list of {group, clause}; each entry is a CONTROL group of V2.2 PA-1.3 that the contract assigns to the scenario through one of these sources, which the clause cites: V2.1 10.8 = an X7 scan cell: the tail log POST_V1_TO_CP_QUEUE_LOG (a NOT_A_CONTROL item) to SC-B (AR3-06, AR3-10); V2.1 10.6 and 21.4 = a residual scan cell to SC-B (AR3-06); V2.2 PA-12 = the qualification control CLOSURE_COMPLETENESS_CONTROL to PR-REC (AR3-06); AR4-03 = a scenario class that V2.1 26.3 and 31 list for a group whose controls the scenario cannot reach by design: the KS-* class to KS and SC-A (the AR4-03 extension of AR3-06). A contract-assigned group is never in GROUPS_SERVED; it is evidence only and never PASS; it is never counted as serving or countable coverage; it never enters N_strict (AR4-14 (a)); its expected group verdict says "evidence only, never PASS"

CONDITIONAL_EXPECTATION_RULES.CER-ABV: resolved offline from the sealed ABORT-VERIFY record of the same run: match => O2; mismatch or unreadable => O6, recorded as an S-5 / AB finding (never charged to the target control)
CONDITIONAL_EXPECTATION_RULES.CER-WIT: resolved offline from the sealed I-14 DELIVERY WITNESS record of the same run at the injection position (an independent subscription of the I-14 instrument, qualified at the X positions by Q-I14-X and at the Y coordinates by Q-I14-Y, XDATA_WRITE and Wr-OCT at Y1 included; AR4-01), never from the E-12 log itself (AR2-12): a result conditional on delivery is the detection branch when the witness records the event delivered and the non-detection branch when it does not. One convention holds for every scenario whose designed detection needs the delivery (AR4-16, AR4-20 (d)): on the non-detection branch the target control's result is PASS (nothing was delivered to detect), the scenario is NOT_RUNNABLE as a negative control of that target, it contributes no designed detection to the target's groups, and the coverage cell stays uncovered (NEGATIVE_CONTROL_NOT_EVALUATED in BA-02b V7, AR3-03)
CONDITIONAL_EXPECTATION_RULES.CER-SIL: RUNNABLE only if the sealed Q-I14-SILENT-Y record (Y coordinates) or Q-I14-SILENT-X record (X coordinates) shows AVAILABLE at the coordinate; otherwise the scenario is recorded NOT_RUNNABLE, the isolation of the target is NOT_ACHIEVED, it contributes no designed detection and its coverage cell stays uncovered (NEGATIVE_CONTROL_NOT_EVALUATED in BA-02b V7, AR3-03, AR4-20 (d))
CONDITIONAL_EXPECTATION_RULES.CER-A2: resolved offline from the sealed I-14 delivery witness record of the same run only (never from the E-12 log, AR2-12), positioned by the V0 and V1 markers: no deferred WRITE_CLASS event on a protected object after V0 => O3, A-2 PASS and E-12 phase C PASS; a deferred event delivered between V0 and V1 (phase C) => O7, A-2 FAIL and E-12 phase C FAIL; a deferred event delivered only after V1 (the tail) => O3, A-2 FAIL and E-12 phase C PASS; an A-2 FAIL gives the group verdict CHARACTERIZED_DIFFERENT (V2.2 PA-1.2). A-1 on the same witness record (V2.1 10.6: the baseline runs without writers evaluate A-1 and A-2): no WRITE_CLASS event on a protected object delivered in W-scan (V0..V1) => A-1 PASS; a delivered W-scan event => A-1 UNKNOWN, because it cannot be attributed to the verifier's read-only opens rather than to a deferred commit (V2.1 14: no origin inference), never A-1 FAIL; A-1 alone is measured by EA1-READONLY-OPENS (V2.1 14.7). The scenario runs on the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD, where I-14 exists (AR4-06 (6); R1:BA04V4-09, second option)
CONDITIONAL_EXPECTATION_RULES.CER-PERSIST: resolved offline from the sealed I-14 independent post-abort read of the changed entity (qualified for Wr-OCT at Y1 by Q-I14-Y, AR4-01; not from ABORT-VERIFY, not from the E-12 log): the change persisted after the abort => S-5 FAIL (ABORT-VERIFY mismatch, unexpected mutation, V2.1 11.3) and O6 (17.2 row 4); it did not persist => S-5 PASS, the product outcome follows CER-ABV (O2 on a match) and the scenario is NOT_RUNNABLE as a negative control of S-5: it contributes no designed detection and its S-5 cell stays uncovered (NEGATIVE_CONTROL_NOT_EVALUATED in BA-02b V7, AR3-03, AR3-04, AR4-20 (d))

BUILD_EQUIVALENCE: BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD (AR4-06 (4); AR5-04): the recorded and verified equivalence of the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD and the PRODUCT_BUILD, in both directions. Its location, content schema (recordKind CT21D_BUILD_EQUIVALENCE) and custody: BA-07 V7 sections 2, 4 and 5.3; use precondition: BA-07 V7 section 7, U5. BA-07 V7 is the single authority for the record (BA-07 is in DEPENDS_ON) and this catalog restates none of them. The rules of this catalog: (a) characterization to product: the pins derived on the characterization build (E04_ADMITTED_SET@R-1 from E4-LEARN-R1-*, LOCK_MODE from LK-*, HOST_DEFAULT_MAP from HDM-CHAR-*) apply to a PRODUCT_BUILD run only under this record, and the E4-VAL-R1 membership post-check stays the safeguard (AR4-06 (4)); every PRODUCT_BUILD scenario that consumes such a pin names the record in RUN_PREREQUISITES; (b) product to characterization (AR5-04, the ruling of AQ-V5-01): EVM_FROZEN, learned and validated on the PRODUCT_BUILD (AR4-01), applies to a governing CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD run only under this record; every such scenario names the record in RUN_PREREQUISITES (AR5-04 (1)); without a cited record EVM_FROZEN does not apply: the run does not start, or E12A and E12C cannot be PASS (AR5-04 (4)); the record's method shows the assemblies present only in the characterization build (the switches, the injection points, the I-14 writers, the witness subscription, DRY_RUN_BRANCH_SWITCH, the declared canaries) neutral in events inside the governed window unless a scenario names them (AR5-04 (3)), and compares the CATALOG_FOLDER hash sets of both profiles (AR5-04 (6)); EA2-DEFERRED-EVENTS is the safeguard in this catalog (AR5-04 (5)). Every run of a scenario that names the record cites the record hash (BA-07 V7 section 4), with its path, in its RUN_START record, sampled together with the BUILD_BOUND fields and the run-start anchor before library acquisition, and its evidence package carries a copy of the record, or its {path, sha256}, next to the canonical tuple record (RUN_PREREQUISITE_RULE, section 4; BA-07 V7 section 7, U5). It is not a pin, not a tuple field and not a seal blocker of this catalog
BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION: BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION_RECORD (AR5-12; G2-CR-03; AR7-04): the bound product SHA (95690c28, AR6-01) is where the static facts of BA-03 V5, BA-06 V7 and BA-08 V7 come from and is never a tuple value; the source SHA of each build under test is the tuple field "repo source SHA of the build" (V2.1 2.1). The precondition of execution preparation of AR5-12 is recorded per build under test by this record (location, content schema (recordKind CT21D_BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION) and custody: BA-07 V7 sections 2, 4 and 5.4; use precondition: BA-07 V7 section 7, U6). The fail-closed detection of a delta is AR5-12's; under AR7-03 the BA-03 runner (BA-03 V5) detects its own pairs and the dedicated precondition verifier (docs/automation/evidence/I-52-ct21d-precondition-verifier.py, outside the BA-11 registry, in BA-07 custody) detects the union of the pairs that BA-03, BA-06 and BA-08 cite and fails closed; the record cites its output (runnerOutput, agnostic of the detector, AR7-05). The rule of this catalog (AR7-04): every scenario whose BUILD_UNDER_TEST is the PRODUCT_BUILD or the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD, governing or not, names the record in RUN_PREREQUISITES; it is MANDATORY for the runs that feed a pin, a selection, the warm-up criterion or the inventory: E4-LEARN-R1-*, LK-*, HDM-CHAR-*, WU-DRY-* (the pin- and selection-feeding runs and the warm-up dry runs of this catalog; the dynamic-trace dry runs that feed the inventory are BA-06 V7 section 7 runs, not scenarios of this catalog, and BA-07 V7 section 7, U6 names them), and every other run on a build under test names it under the same single rule. Every run of such a scenario cites the record hash, with its path, in RUN_START (its first log record), sampled together with the BUILD_BOUND fields and the run-start anchor before library acquisition, and its evidence package carries a copy of the record, or its {path, sha256}, next to the canonical tuple record (RUN_PREREQUISITE_RULE, section 4; AR7-05). A synthetic scenario (BUILD_UNDER_TEST NONE) has no build under test and names none; the FIXTURE_CONSTRUCTION_BUILD is never a build under test and has no record (FXB-03). It is not a pin, not a tuple field and not a seal blocker of this catalog

RUN_PREREQUISITE_VOCABULARY.BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD: the recorded, verified equivalence of the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD and the PRODUCT_BUILD (AR4-06 (4); AR5-04; section 1.1), in both directions: a prerequisite of every PRODUCT_BUILD run that consumes a pin derived on the characterization build (E04_ADMITTED_SET@R-1, LOCK_MODE, HOST_DEFAULT_MAP; AR4-06 (4)) and of every governing CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD run that consumes EVM_FROZEN, learned and validated on the PRODUCT_BUILD (AR5-04 (1)), which cites it in RUN_START; without it the pins do not apply (AR4-06 (4)) and EVM_FROZEN does not apply (AR5-04 (4)); location, content schema (recordKind CT21D_BUILD_EQUIVALENCE) and custody: BA-07 V7 sections 2, 4 and 5.3; use precondition: BA-07 V7 section 7, U5
RUN_PREREQUISITE_VOCABULARY.BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION_RECORD: the bound-SHA precondition record of AR5-12 for the build under test of the run (recordKind CT21D_BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION): every (path, blob) pair of the reused product route that BA-03, BA-06 and BA-08 cite at the bound product SHA (95690c28, AR6-01; never a tuple value, AR5-12) equals the pair at the source SHA of the build, or the delta was recorded and processed (result EQUAL, or DELTA_PROCESSED with citedArtifactsUnchanged = true, BA-07 V7 section 5.4); the fail-closed detection of a delta is AR5-12's: the BA-03 runner (BA-03 V5) detects its own pairs, and the dedicated precondition verifier of AR7-03 (docs/automation/evidence/I-52-ct21d-precondition-verifier.py, an execution-preparation tool outside the BA-11 registry, in BA-07 custody) detects the union of the pairs that BA-03, BA-06 and BA-08 cite and fails closed; the record cites the verifier's output (runnerOutput, agnostic of the detector, AR7-05); a prerequisite of every run on the PRODUCT_BUILD or the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD, governing or not (AR7-04; G2-CR-03); no record serves a synthetic run (BUILD_UNDER_TEST NONE) or the FIXTURE_CONSTRUCTION_BUILD, which runs no scenario (FXB-03); location, content schema and custody: BA-07 V7 sections 2, 4 and 5.4; use precondition: BA-07 V7 section 7, U6

RUN_PREREQUISITE_RULE: Every run of a scenario cites, in its first log record (RUN_START, or QUAL_START for a qualification run), the name and the SHA-256 of every record that the scenario's RUN_PREREQUISITES names (for a learning run, the REVIEWED_REF record of LP-LEARN is that citation for the REVIEWED_RECORD). A run that does not cite a named record, or whose cited record is not in the state the vocabulary requires, does not meet the prerequisite: for the BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD, the pins derived on the characterization build do not apply to a PRODUCT_BUILD run (AR4-06 (4)), and EVM_FROZEN does not apply to a CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD run, which then does not start or cannot give PASS for E12A or E12C (AR5-04 (4)); for the BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION_RECORD, the precondition of execution preparation of AR5-12 is not met for the run's build and the run does not start; for the REVIEWED_RECORD, the run does not meet V2.4 and does not enter the learning corpus (BA-06 V7 section 9); for a qualification record, the instrument is not qualified for the run (V2.1 4.3: no PASS). The BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD, the BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION_RECORD and the REVIEWED_RECORD are review records in BA-07 custody whose REVIEW_RECORD_ADDED entry has an index at most the h of the run-start anchor of the run: for the BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD, the use precondition of BA-07 V7 section 7, U5 (the record and its custody: BA-07 V7 section 5.3; the SHA-256 it is cited by is its record hash, BA-07 V7 section 4); for the BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION_RECORD, the use precondition of BA-07 V7 section 7, U6 (the record and its custody: BA-07 V7 section 5.4; cited by its record hash, BA-07 V7 section 4); for the REVIEWED_RECORD, BA-07 V7 sections 5.1, 6.1 and 7, U1; the qualification records are the sealed records of the named scenarios on the build of the run. For the BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD and the BOUND_SHA_PRECONDITION_RECORD the citation is the one of BA-07 V7 sections 5.3, 5.4 and 7 (U5, U6; AR7-05): the record hash, with its path, is cited in RUN_START (the run's first log record; QUAL_START for a qualification run), sampled together with the BUILD_BOUND fields and the run-start anchor before library acquisition; the run's evidence package carries a copy of the record, or its {path, sha256}, next to the canonical tuple record
A1_EVALUATION: A-1 is exercised by EA1-READONLY-OPENS (the measurement of the read-only opens alone, V2.1 14.7) and by the members of the PARAM-03 clean sample, the governing CL-CLEAN-<fixture> scenarios and EA2-DEFERRED-EVENTS, which are the baseline runs without any writer that V2.1 10.6 says evaluate A-1 and A-2; no other mirror run exercises A-1. In such a mirror run A-1 is evaluated on the W-scan record (V0..V1): no WRITE_CLASS event on a protected object in W-scan => A-1 PASS; an event in W-scan => A-1 UNKNOWN, never FAIL, because it cannot be attributed to the verifier's read-only opens rather than to a deferred commit (V2.1 14: no origin inference). In a CL-CLEAN-<fixture> run (PRODUCT_BUILD) the W-scan record is the run's own E-12 phase-C record, the one that evaluates E-12 phase C; the expected A-1 result is PASS, as every E-12 phase-C result of a clean run is (an event there makes E-12 phase C FAIL, O7, a false rejection of the sample, and A-1 UNKNOWN). In EA2-DEFERRED-EVENTS (CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD) A-1 is conditional by CER-A2, resolved from the I-14 delivery witness (AR2-12)
ENFORCED_NOT_EXERCISED_RULE: Enforced, not exercised (EV-L-*; AR4-01). In a learning micro-scenario EV-L-OC-* and in the composition check EV-L-COMPOSED, the controls the run enforces (E-03 under the LOCK_MODE pin; every other control, fail-closed, of the manifest-attested environment of V2.1 27.2 step 2) are entry conditions of the learning environment, not results the scenario characterizes: they are not in CONTROLS_EXERCISED, a registry key of one of them in EXPECTED_CONTROL_RESULTS carries a value that begins with ENFORCED_NOT_EXERCISED, their PASS is never coverage, and their FAIL refuses the run and counts toward the control's group (BA-02b V7 rule 2). Authority: AR4-01, which rules these runs to be governing runs of the evidence group E12-L (V2.2 PA-3: verdict EVIDENCE_COMPLETE), E-03 enforced and every other control fail-closed; exercising E-03 would add LK to GROUPS_SERVED against that assignment (checked mechanically)

SEALED_AT_RULE.serialization: a JSON object holding exactly these fields of the scenario with their values as written in this file; keys sorted by Unicode code point (every key is ASCII); UTF-8; no insignificant whitespace (separators "," and ":"); no ASCII escaping of non-ASCII characters; arrays keep their order; every value is a string, an array or an object (no number, boolean or null), so the text equals its RFC 8785 (JCS) form; no trailing newline
SEALED_AT_RULE.hash: SHA-256 of those UTF-8 bytes, 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
SEALED_AT_RULE.scope: SEALED_AT covers the expectation of one scenario, the fields that decide which group verdicts it contributes to (GROUP, EVIDENCE_GROUPS_DECLARED, CONTRACT_ASSIGNED_GROUPS; R1:BA04V4-10, R2:BA04V4-09) and its planned repetition (REPETITION, RETRY_APPLICABILITY). GROUPS_SERVED and CONTROL_CLASSES_EXERCISED are not listed because each is a function of hashed fields (CONTROLS_EXERCISED, EVIDENCE_GROUPS_DECLARED, CONTRACT_ASSIGNED_GROUPS) and of the BA-02a registry, a DEPENDS_ON entry whose new version cascades to this artifact; PURPOSE, INPUT_STATUS, STATUS, BLOCKED_BY and NOTE are not expectation fields: a change of any of them is covered by the artifact-level hash and needs a new catalog version. The catalog-level definitions a scenario names (DEFAULTS, REPETITION_RULES, LOG_PROFILES, CONDITIONAL_EXPECTATION_RULES, REGISTRY_MAP, GROUP_TABLE, BUILD_PROFILES, RUN_PREREQUISITE_VOCABULARY) are covered by the artifact-level hash of BA-04 only. SEALED_AT is computed and written before the BA-04 candidate ruling, inside its bytes (AR3-25); the catalog is sealed at artifact level only

EXPECTED_CONTROL_RESULTS.instrument I-12: every DIGEST reproduced byte for byte; every UNKNOWN reproduced; every REJECTED input (rejectedInputs RJ-01..RJ-25) reproduced as REJECTED; every semantic result reproduced on the generated binary64 instances. Each slot-unit instance is checked by the realized quantity of its predicate, as BA-05 V5 section 3.3.1 states it (semanticSlotInstanceRule): ABS_DIFF_LE, the exact difference computed in rational arithmetic on the binary64 values; ANGLE_DIFF_LE, the wrapped difference of the binary64 angles under the sealed NORM_ANGLE rule, evaluated as a certified enclosure with exact pi; NORMAL_ANGLE_LE, the angle between the normalized binary64 vectors, evaluated as a certified enclosure. An EQUAL vector needs the whole enclosure at most the slot and a DIFFERENT vector needs it above the slot; an instance whose check fails, or whose enclosure straddles the slot, is INVALID and reported, never PASS

The FIXTURE_CONSTRUCTION_BUILD is a third build role: never a BUILD_UNDER_TEST value, never in CHARACTERIZATION_TUPLE or RUN_START, outside the precondition of AR5-12 (FXB-03), and no other build substitutes it (FXB-04). Label text (FXB-07): the purpose (the mirror creates RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES because its label is non-blank) does not depend on I60_NAMING_FOR_RACKMIRROR; the expected label text does: under NOT_YET_ADOPTED the mirror is "Rack - espejo" (V17 PDC-2; BA-08 V7 section 15); a later adoption would re-derive only the SL-D label text of this scenario, never SL-Y.
